'''T'Seely''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hasikian]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
As a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], T'Seely joined the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi academy|academy]], where he began [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Stationed at the Temple at the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict which erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], T'Seely was assigned to pilot a shuttle to carry [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] to conduct a meeting with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] concerning the state of affairs in the war-torn Republic. T'Seely was concerned for the safety of Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and Knight [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], as he had heard many rumors floating around the Temple as to who survived the costly [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="TCWWS" />

Sometime later, around the time of the [[Fall of Falleen]], T'Seely was [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|knighted]] in an attempt to bring more Knights into the war effort. Ascending to the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], T'Seely was stationed at the Temple and assigned as an aide to Communications Chief [[Ban-yaro]] in the [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|Temple's comm center]]. While there, the Hasikian received an urgent message sent by Senator Organa for Master Kenobi, and relayed it to the Jedi Master in the [[Situation Room/Legends|Situation Room]].<ref name="TCWWS" />
